what I did was I sat down for about a day, day and a half of of building a React site that was basically the
world's slowest humanpowered LLM. It was way less than one token per second because it would show one letter and my dad would it would scroll by until it
was the letter he wanted. For example, if he was thirsty, the T would eventually be coming up and he would push the space bar or the trackpad with

spelling words and telling me what he needed. And eventually, we would piece words together and he would have sentences. And in this way, he wasn't

in the bed with no way to communicate what he needed. And I don't share this with you to elicit sympathy. I'm sharing this with
